SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. B. REGI ..
File No.
No. D
Special Branch S.2. 8/9/10/11
REPORT
Date November 21, 1933.

Subject (in full) Communist propaganda found in Pootoo Road District on 18-11-33.

Made by D. I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [签名]

Sixty copies of a communist handbill entitled "Letter of
protest opposing the joint attack on the Chinese Red Army by
the imperialists and Chinese militarists," issued by the Far
Eastern Anti-War and Anti-Fascist Congress and dated September 30,
1933, were found by the Municipal Police on Pootoo Road on the
night of November 18.
A summarized translation of the contents of this handbill
is given hereunder :-
"Under the efficient guidance of the Chinese Communist
Party the Red Army has successfully crushed the four suppression
campaigns of the Kuomintang and, moreover, has actually extended
the Soviet Districts. At the present moment the Kuomintang is
preparing to launch a 5th Offensive against the Red Army, while
American, British and Japanese warships concentrate on Fukien
seas as a preparatory step to attacking the Red Army in North
Fokien.
"The Far Eastern Anti-War and Anti-Fascist Congress of the
World Anti-Imperialist League calls upon the toiling masses of
China and the world to oppose the partitioning of China and the
massacring of Chinese masses by imperialists; to demand the
immediate withdrawal of all imperialist forces from China; to
urge Chinese soldiers to support the Chinese Soviet and to refuse
to fight against the Red Army."

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

[批：B.R. 21/11/33]
[批：File 21/11]
[印：REC'D NOV 21 1933]
Officer i/c Special Branch.

报告
日期：1933年11月21日。

主题（全称）：1933年11月18日在普陀路地区发现的共产主义宣传品。

制作人：侦探督察 顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa） 转呈人：[签名]

1933年11月18日晚，市警察在普陀路发现了六十份共产主义传单，题为《反对帝国主义与中国军阀联合进攻中国红军的抗议书》，由远东反战反法西斯大会发布，日期为1933年9月30日。
现将该传单内容摘要翻译如下：
“在中国共产党的有效指导下，红军已成功粉碎了国民党的四次围剿战役，并且实际上扩大了苏区。目前，国民党正准备发动对红军的第五次进攻，而美国、英国和日本的军舰正集结于福建海域，作为进攻闽北红军的前奏步骤。
“世界反帝联盟的远东反战反法西斯大会呼吁中国和全世界的劳苦大众反对帝国主义瓜分中国和屠杀中国民众；要求所有帝国主义势力立即撤出中国；敦促中国士兵支持中华苏维埃，并拒绝与红军作战。”

顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）
侦探督察

[批注：B.R. 1933年11月21日]
[批注：归档 1933年11月21日]
[印章：1933年11月21日 收讫]
特别支部主管警官。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE. No. D
S. B. REGI
File No.
Special Branch S.2. 916/33.
REPORT
Date November 21, 1933.

Subject (in full) Communist propaganda found in Louza district on 19-11-33.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [Signature]

During the evening of November 19 some thirty copies of
a communist handbill issued by the "Chinese Young Men's Anti-
Fascist Flying Squad" were found by the Municipal Police on
Nanking Road in the vicinity of Kweichow Road.

A summarized translation of the contents of the handbill
is given hereunder :-

"The Kuomintang shamelessly sold the Four North-Eastern
Provinces to Japan and is now welcoming other imperialistic
powers to participate in the partitioning of China. The
Kuomintang has furthermore adopted the "Fascist" policy and
is suppressing the activities of all anti-Japanese and anti-
imperialist organizations. The working classes are being
deprived of freedom of speech and assembly. To overthrow
the imperialists we must first crush the Kuomintang Fascist
Party. The Chinese Young Men's Anti-Fascist Flying Squad
calls upon all labourers, students and citizens of Shanghai
to unite and wage a desperate struggle with the Kuomintang
Fascists."

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
The above is correct in L.R. 2/10.
[Signature] [Signature]

报告
日期：1933年11月21日。

主题（全称）：1933年11月19日在老闸地区发现的共产主义宣传品。

制作人：侦探督察 顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa） 转呈人：[签名]

11月19日晚，市警察在南京路近贵州路一带发现了约三十份由“中国青年反法西斯飞行队”发布的共产主义传单。
现将该传单内容摘要翻译如下：

“国民党无耻地将东北四省出卖给日本，现在又欢迎其他帝国主义列强参与瓜分中国。此外，国民党采取了‘法西斯’政策，镇压所有抗日和反帝国主义组织的活动。工人阶级被剥夺了言论和集会自由。为了推翻帝国主义，我们必须首先粉碎国民党法西斯党。中国青年反法西斯飞行队呼吁上海的所有劳工、学生和市民团结起来，与国民党法西斯分子进行殊死斗争。”

顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）
侦探督察

特别支部主管警官。
上述内容在 L.R. 2/10 中确认无误。
[签名] [签名]
